tagline: Autonomous AI Code Review & Security Gatekeeper
brief: Open-source, self-hosted, model-agnostic code review engine for GitHub PRs. Surgical precision, Stage F finding validation, and deterministic secret leak prevention.

concepts.name: 1. The Hex Prism
concepts.idea: Precision hexagonal aperture with code chevrons for deep-dive inspection.
rationale: Hexagonal geometry signals precision engineering and compiler optics.
High legibility down to 16px favicon scale.
Fits naturally alongside modern developer tooling ecosystems.

concepts.name: 2. The Merge Shield
concepts.idea: Converging git branch lines interlocking into a security verification shield.
rationale: Unmistakable symbol of CI/CD protection and gatekeeper security.
Built-in checkmark glyph communicates verified code quality.
Bold, confident presence on dark mode interfaces.

concepts.name: 3. The Hex Shield (Hybrid)
concepts.idea: Architectural fusion of the hexagonal code chevron and the protective gatekeeper checkmark.
rationale: Synthesizes the optical code chevron of Concept 1 with the protective checkmark of Concept 2.
Balances security verification with code intelligence.
Zero trademark collisions; completely distinct developer brand.

recommendation: Concept 2 (The Merge Shield) or Concept 3 (The Hex Shield Hybrid) provide the strongest immediate visual cue that ReviewBot is a security gatekeeper protecting the codebase.
